decision.case_state: Quote (£605, VAT unstated) recorded and sent to landlord at event 013; landlord has not replied. Provider claims phone approval (hearsay). Ticket on hold, review 2024-10-11.

next_actions.action: Ask landlord for a yes/no written approval of the £605 quote
Told provider not to order or start until written approval; asked for VAT status and quote document

boundaries: Recording the quote does not approve it
Provider's phone claim is not landlord authority
No contractor instruction or spend committed
remaining_work: Landlord written decision (owner: landlord; agency chases 2024-10-11)
Then record decision, approve quote, arrange work and tell tenant/provider
Confirm VAT and quote document from provider
decision.summary: Provider says the landlord approved by phone, which is hearsay. I recorded the quote, asked the landlord for written yes/no, told the provider not to order or start, and held the ticket for review on 2024-10-11.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Quote of £605 awaits landlord approval; only the provider's unverified phone claim exists. Outstanding: written approval, VAT confirmation, scheduling.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Landlord approval request by email (A2), provider told to hold off by email (A3), hold until 2024-10-11 (A4).

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. The decision is the landlord's and is routine to chase; no escalation needed yet.
